articles.title_en: Russia Pounds Kyiv With Missiles, Killing At Least 9
articles.lead_en: This is the second major attack on Kyiv this week, with fires across the city and power outages reported in some areas.

articles.title_en: Ukraine hits two more Wildberries warehouses in Russia
articles.lead_en: A fire broke out at a Wildberries marketplace logistics facility in Volgograd following a Ukrainian drone attack, the company said. No employees were injured, according to preliminary reports.

articles.title_en: At least six members of one family killed in Russian missile strike near Kryvyi Rih. Rescue workers are still searching the rubble for three more people.
articles.lead_en: A Russian missile strike killed multiple members of one family — a father, a mother, and at least four of their children — in the village of Radushne in Ukraine’s Dnipropetrovsk region.
